news.headline: Meta Reevaluating 2030 Net Zero Emissions Goal
news.summary: Meta is reconsidering its 2030 net zero emissions target, citing the significant energy demands of its ongoing artificial intelligence infrastructure buildout.

news.headline: Third Point LLC Exits Entire Stake in Amazon
news.summary: Hedge fund Third Point LLC, led by Dan Loeb, has fully divested its position in Amazon according to recent 13F filings.

news.headline: ISS Recommends Shareholders Vote Against Tesla Chair Robyn Denholm
news.summary: Proxy advisory firm Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) has advised Tesla shareholders to vote against the reappointment of Chair Robyn Denholm at the company's upcoming annual meeting.

news.headline: Meta to Price Muse Charm AI Device at $300
news.summary: Meta Platforms, Inc. plans to launch its Muse Charm AI device at a $300 price point, including a 12-month free 5G data plan from Verizon.

news.headline: NVIDIA to Present at 30th Annual UBS Global Technology and AI Conference
news.summary: NVIDIA announced it will participate in the 30th Annual UBS Global Technology and AI Conference scheduled for December 1, 2026.

news.headline: U.K. Tribunal Orders Government to Confirm Secret Demand for Apple Customer Data
news.summary: The U.K. Investigatory Powers Tribunal has ordered the government to confirm it issued a secret technical order requiring Apple to provide encrypted customer information.

news.headline: Anthropic IPO Valuation and Amazon's Stake Disclosure
news.summary: Following Anthropic's IPO, reports indicate Amazon holds a 14.7% stake in the AI company, valued at over $159 billion.

news.headline: JPMorgan Chase Named Associate Sponsor for Wreaths Across America Radio
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase has been announced as an associate sponsor for Wreaths Across America Radio's 2026 'Escort to Arlington' coverage.

news.headline: Apple Camera and Photos Software Chief Jon McCormack Departs
news.summary: Jon McCormack, the head of Apple's camera and photo software, has reportedly left the company.

news.headline: Tesla Developing Steering Wheel-Free Model Y Version
news.summary: CEO Elon Musk confirmed that Tesla is working on a version of the Model Y SUV that will be designed without a steering wheel or pedals.

news.headline: Tesla Commences Commercial Operation of Megapack System in Oita, Japan
news.summary: Tesla has brought a 30 MW / 125 MWh Megapack battery energy storage system into commercial operation alongside a solar project in Oita, Japan.

news.headline: Teleport Achieves AWS Security Competency Status
news.summary: Teleport, an AI infrastructure identity company, has been awarded Amazon Web Services (AWS) Security Competency status in the Identity and Access Management category.

news.headline: J.P. Morgan Asset Management Launches JPMorgan All Country Research Enhanced Equity ETF (JALL)
news.summary: J.P. Morgan Asset Management has launched a new actively managed ETF, JALL, on NYSE Arca to provide core global equity exposure.

news.headline: Apple Announces 2026 Black Friday Shopping Event
news.summary: Apple has announced its annual Black Friday shopping event, scheduled for November 27 through November 30, 2026, featuring Apple Gift Cards of up to $300 with the purchase of eligible products.

news.headline: Profound Launches Integrations for Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365
news.summary: Marketing AI platform Profound has introduced new integrations connecting its services with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Outlook.

news.headline: JPMorgan Chase Reports Cyberattack on Third-Party Vendors
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase announced that a cyberattack targeting third-party service providers resulted in the exposure of certain customer information.
